name: – Karin Karlsbro – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the termination of the Voluntary Partnership Agreement between the European Union and the Republic of Liberia on forest law enforcement, governance and trade in timber products to the European Union
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to end a 2013 timber trade agreement between the European Union and Liberia. Under that agreement, Liberia was meant to make sure its timber was legally produced and properly governed before it was sold to Europe. The report says Liberia has not kept its side of the deal. The Parliament's trade committee believes ending the agreement is the best option, since the deal can only work if both sides keep their promises.

- The European Union and Liberia end their timber trade agreement, in force since 2013.
- It affects Liberia's timber trade with Europe and everyone working in that trade.
- The Parliament has given its consent; the Council can now formally end the agreement.
